description:
Minimal permissions for CoreCode frontend (principle of least privilege).

RETAINED:
- core:event:allow-listen / allow-unlisten: Frontend listens for 'terminal-data' and
  'terminal-exit' events emitted by the Rust PTY backend (terminal.rs).
- dialog:allow-open: File-open and folder-open picker dialogs (editor.js openFolderDialog,
  openFileDialog).
- dialog:allow-confirm: Confirmation dialog for destructive SCM actions (editor.js
  scmActionDiscard).
- dialog:allow-message: Tauri-intercepted browser `alert()` (editor.js scmCommit failure
  path) and webview-default unhandled-rejection handler route here. Re-added to silence
  spurious permission errors that surfaced during normal use.

REMOVED (previously granted by broad default sets):
- core:default (included ~88 permissions across path/event/window/webview/app/image/
  resources/menu/tray sub-plugins — none used from JS). Custom Tauri commands registered
  in generate_handler! are accessible without core plugin permissions.
- core:event:allow-emit / allow-emit-to: emit is only called server-side (Rust
  terminal.rs); frontend never emits events.
- dialog:allow-ask / allow-save: No call sites use ask() or save() dialogs.
- fs:default: Frontend never calls window.__TAURI__.fs; all file I/O goes through
  custom Tauri commands (open_file, save_file, read_directory, etc.) which have
  unrestricted filesystem access from the Rust side.
- shell:allow-open: Frontend never calls window.__TAURI__.shell. If external URL
  opening is needed later, add back with a scope restricted to https/http URLs.
